A_VOLATILITY.name: Volatility Regime
A_VOLATILITY.economic_rationale: High-volatility environments may alter predictive relationships by changing investor risk appetite, cross-sectional dispersion, and mean-reversion speed.

BINARY.description: Binary regime: high volatility vs. low volatility

B_INTEREST_RATE.name: Interest Rate Regime
B_INTEREST_RATE.economic_rationale: Rate level and curve shape affect discount rates, financing conditions, growth expectations, and sector valuations differently.

BINARY_LEVEL.description: Binary regime: high rate level vs. low rate level

C_MARKET_TREND.name: Market Trend / Stress Regime
C_MARKET_TREND.economic_rationale: Market stress environments may alter correlation structure, dispersion, and trend persistence, changing how price-derived features predict forward returns.

BINARY_TREND.description: Binary regime: positive trend vs. negative trend

design_rules: All thresholds are objectively specified before seeing results
No manual threshold adjustment after inspecting IC values
Rolling windows use only past data (PIT-safe)
Regime definitions are locked before execution
